summary: Toronto, Ontario, medical device industry professional, experience in software development and scientific software, expertise in image processing and signal processing, background in neurosurgery applications, interest in machine learning and numerical analysis, strong understanding of medical imaging technologies (MRI, CT), familiarity with ISO standards (ISO 13485, IEC 60601), engaged in startup culture, advocates for high-performance computing in medical applications, critical of simplistic views on programming and software engineering, values evidence-based discussions on healthcare and technology, emphasizes the importance of understanding underlying mathematics in programming and algorithms.
